title: Acquisition request preview
readOnlyNote: Read-only view of the currently applied acquisition settings. This does not connect to the PLC, save settings, or confirm readiness. Recording windows are separate.
unsaved: Save the source settings before previewing. Unsaved fields are not estimated here.
scopeUnavailable: The current workspace version is unavailable, so no estimate can be shown. Save any unsaved changes before reloading this page.
loading: Reading the currently applied acquisition settings…
stale: The acquisition settings or workspace changed, so the previous preview is no longer valid. Refresh the preview first. If it remains out of date, save any unsaved changes before reloading this page.
foreign: This source is not available in the current workspace.
unavailable: The currently applied acquisition settings are unavailable. No estimate can be shown.
estimateNote: Estimates: planned protocol read requests per group scan, excluding fault retries. Groups keep their own collection cadence; these are not TCP packet or SQL write counts.
emptyInstalled: The currently applied acquisition settings contain no polling groups.

basis.declared_no_connection: Based on declared capability; no existing connection is present. No connection was opened for this preview.
basis.declared_current_connection: Based on the device’s declared capability and its current existing connection.
basis.safe_current_connection: The existing connection uses a safe initial strategy. This is not a fallback triggered during the current scan.

wireUnitsTitle: Unique physical address units (excluding bridge gaps)
actualUnavailable: No matching completed scheduled-scan observation is available. This is not a measured zero.
wireSubsetNote: Retry and fallback sends may overlap and are subsets of actual wire sends. Do not add them. Logical request outcomes below use a different unit.
logicalNotStarted: No logical request entered execution; request outcomes are unavailable, not zero.
overrun: This scan exceeded its collection cadence.
withinCadence: This scan did not exceed its collection cadence.
lastGoodUnavailable: No matching Good-completion age is available.
lossPartial: Partial retained detail only; history is incomplete. Missing rows do not mean zero loss. These are not wire or SQL failure counts.
lossUnavailable: Matching retained output-loss detail is unavailable; no scoped total can be inferred.
frameCost: Planned frame size: request {{request}} bytes · response {{response}} bytes
frameCostUnavailable: Frame size is unavailable, not measured zero.
limitsUnavailable: No per-request limit detail is available.
